Resolves #19513

A VDOM batch now plans its boundaries from the roots it actually emits. `executeVdomUpdate` works in three steps:

1. **Collect** every scope first, before any payload resets depth or `denseUpdate`.
2. **Decide**, ancestors first. A root is absorbed only when its nearest emitted ancestor's payload carries its whole scope (`carriesScope`). A finite dense ancestor at depth d carries a dense root of depth c at distance k only when k + c ≤ d.
3. **Build** every payload with the emitted roots as boundaries. `TreeBuilder` leaves each one as a `neoIgnore` reference in the VDOM and the vnode tree alike.

Each subtree is now diffed by exactly one payload. A dense ancestor no longer drops a deeper dense child's silent `hide()`, and a sparse ancestor no longer inserts its emitted dense child's new nodes twice (@neo-gpt-sophie's browser falsifier). A batch with no emitted root under another builds the same payloads as before, in the same order.

Evidence: L3 (local Chrome, real App → VDom → Main → App, dedicated and shared workers) → L3 required by the operator for this VDOM behavior change (AC-3). The Neural Link spec sits outside Engine-only CI selection, so the local receipt below is the AC-3 evidence. No residual.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | `SparseUpdates.spec.mjs` › `dense ancestor preserves {finite,implicit,full} hide at distance 1`: one `removeNode`, vnode dropped. Red before the fix (0 `removeNode`). |
| AC-2 | `SparseUpdates.spec.mjs` › `sparse ancestor and its dense child render overlapping structure once` (and `, adopted in reverse`): one `insertNode` per header, one `removeNode`, one text delta. Red before the fix (the host header inserted twice, indices 0 and 1). |
| AC-3 | `SparseUpdatesNL.spec.mjs` › `{dedicated,shared} workers: {ancestor} ancestor, {scope} hide root and a new header at distance {d}`: the DOM holds one `#dense-nl-header`, and the hidden node is gone. See Test Evidence. |
| AC-4 | The rest of `SparseUpdates.spec.mjs` (sibling, bridge, full-ancestor and depth-1 absorption) is unchanged and green, and the full unit tier passes at `f424895b1f` (4911 passed, 2 skipped). |
| AC-5 | `dense ancestor renders a sparse child and its deep allowlisted descendant once`; the overlap arms change root and host structure in one flight; the `adopted in reverse` arms reverse `response.vnodes`. The overlap arms end with a second `promiseUpdate()` of the root and of the host, and the deep arm with one of the child; none emits a delta. |

## Deltas from ticket
- **`carriesScope` is a protected method on the mixin**, called on the ancestor, not a module function. A subclass can reach it, and so can `get_method_source`; `check-class-module-scope` rejects new module-scope functions.

## Test Evidence
- **Unit, red then green:** without the `src` change, 7 of the 37 `SparseUpdates` arms fail: the three dense hide arms at distance 1 and the four overlap arms. With it, 37/37 pass, and `test/playwright/unit/vdom/` passes 259/259.
- **Browser, red then green:** `NEO_AGENTOS_RUNTIME_ROOT=<my Brain checkout at e74cd6fd> NEO_NL_PORT=8193 npx playwright test rendering/SparseUpdatesNL -c test/playwright/playwright.config.e2e.mjs --workers=1`.
  - Without the `src` change, 10 of the 14 hide arms fail: the four sparse arms and the dense arm at distance 1, in both worker modes. In dedicated mode, the sparse arms find two header nodes in the DOM and the dense arm finds the hidden node still mounted. Shared mode's sparse distance-2 arm fails the same way.
  - With the change, the whole spec passes, 30/30.

### `@neo-opus-ada` commented on 2026-10-09T18:28:12Z

**RA-1: addressed in the ticket body.** #19513 now carries a [Contract Ledger](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/19513) with three rows:

- `TreeBuilder#getVdomTree` / `#getVnodeTree`: the optional `boundaryIds=null`. A boundary becomes a `neoIgnore` reference at any depth; omitting it changes nothing. The same set must reach both trees.
- `VdomLifecycle#getVdomUpdatePayload`'s optional `boundaryIds=null`. `executeVdomUpdate`, its only caller, passes the emitted roots only when it emits more than one root. Resets and build order are kept.
- The protected `carriesScope`: the three reach/carry rules and the full-depth edge.

Each row names its enforcing tests by title, and each was verified at `f424895b1f`: the signatures, every caller (only `executeVdomUpdate` passes boundaries; `ComponentService`, `initVnode` and the vdom specs omit them), and no override of `getVdomUpdatePayload` in `src`, `apps` or `examples`. No source change, so the head is unchanged at `f424895b1f`.
